parts.0.title: Hören — Listening
parts.0.instructions: Listen to each item and choose the right answer. In the real exam each item is played once or twice; here you can listen as often as you like, but try to listen at most twice.
parts.1.title: Lesen — Reading
parts.1.instructions: Read each text and choose the right answer. Richtig = correct, Falsch = wrong.
writing.0.taskBn: You are writing to your colleague Herr Koch: tomorrow you will come to the office late (you have to see a doctor). Ask whether someone can take notes for you in the morning meeting. Write about 30–40 words.
writing.1.taskBn: Your friend Daniel's birthday is coming up. Write to him: send good wishes; say you can (or cannot) come to the party and give the reason; ask what gift you should bring. Write about 40–50 words.
speaking.0.instructions: Say 2–3 sentences about the topic on each card (about 30 seconds). Then compare with the model.
speaking.1.instructions: You and your friend are making a small plan. Make suggestions, ask questions, agree and decide.
speaking.1.prompts.0.bn: Course party — when, what food, who brings what?
speaking.1.prompts.1.bn: Cinema — which film, when, where to meet?
speaking.1.prompts.2.bn: Weekend trip — where, how, what to take?
speaking.2.instructions: Make a polite request or suggestion; when you hear a request, respond (Ja, gern! / Tut mir leid, aber …).
speaking.2.prompts.0.bn: Ask for help in a shop when you can't find something
